lean.name: UpperTheory.V.Af.NumberSp4
lean.note: This proposition asks for one size-controlled nonzero integer whose ℓ-adic absolute value is at most the product of the Frobenius trace differences from the Eisenstein trace, measured ℓ-adically on admissible GSp₄ representations. It is outside the final dependency cone, where a unitary-group congruence number plays this role.
